sources.title: AI Profit Blueprint Scam EXPOSED - Full Investigation
sources.snippet: A big part of the AI Profit Blueprint model is the long form video, usually around 30 minutes or MORE. These videos often: It opens with a personal "rags to relief" story, like a person who was behind on bills, stressed about rent, or struggling after a job loss, then claims they found a simple phone method that changed everything fast.

sources.title: Models | OpenCode
sources.snippet: Here the full ID is provider_id/model_id. For example, if you're using OpenCode Zen, you would use opencode/gpt-5.1-codex for GPT 5.1 Codex. If you've configured a custom provider, the provider_id is key from the provider part of your config, and the model_id is the key from provider.models.
